row.notes: builds a weekend group classification (group 1 Qualifying, 2 SprintShootout; others return) into result = &map node value at Weekend+0x488 (std::map<u8 group, GroupResult>): clears the 0x60-byte rows (result+0x08..+0x10), adds one row per Weekend+0x288 participant not flagged 0x20 at +0x4b (position +0x50 = 0x1c), then walks the group's sessions last to first and copies each Session+0x70 result row (pos, fastest-lap rank, status) the cut allows onto the matching row. Callers: 0x140af83a0 (last session of a group done) and the rebuild-all 0x140af8f90 (load)
